stem: A client has confirmed folate deficiency. Which red blood cell pattern is most consistent with this deficiency?

options.B: Microcytosis caused by impaired iron incorporation
options.D: Normal red blood cell morphology in all cases

rationale: Mayo Clinic Laboratories states that significant folate deficiency is characteristically associated with macrocytosis and megaloblastic anemia. Therefore A is the best answer. Microcytosis is more characteristic of iron-related disorders, folate deficiency does not cause polycythemia, and it can affect red blood cell morphology rather than guaranteeing normal morphology.
educational_objective: Recognize macrocytosis and megaloblastic anemia as characteristic hematologic manifestations of significant folate deficiency.
